title: refactor: run managed prompt agents in gen
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Runs managed prompt and MCP agent execution inside Gen.
- Routes child model and MCP calls through public Gen with scoped run tokens, preserving billing, caching, and tracking.
- Keeps Enter responsible only for agent configuration and public metadata.
- Removes Enter's private agent runtime and unused Chat serialization route.

Tests:
- Gen and Enter typechecks
- Managed Responses and Chat billing integration
- Managed runtime and Responses tests
- Managed-agent lifecycle and Enter config tests
- Gen and Enter staging builds

gist.headline: Agents moved into the garden
gist.blurb: Managed prompt and MCP agents now do their actual buzzing inside Gen. Their child model calls carry scoped run tokens, so billing, caching, and tracking follow the whole little expedition.
gist.summary: Moved managed prompt and MCP agent execution from Enter into Gen, routing child model and MCP calls through the public Gen API with scoped run tokens while Enter retains agent configuration and public metadata.
gist.impact: Managed agent runs now keep billing, caching, and tracking intact across their child model and MCP calls through Gen, with the old private Enter runtime retired.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy handoff scene: Polli guides tiny prompt-agent seedlings from an Enter gateway garden into a welcoming Gen greenhouse, where scoped token badges travel with each plant to connected model terminals and MCP tool sheds. The move should read as a clean internal routing upgrade, with glowing paths representing preserved billing, caching, and tracking.
